description: LB-8 owner-preservation regression: TWO DISTINCT generic for-in instantiations (Box<Int> yields once, Twice<Int> yields twice) bracketing a non-Copy ConstShare loop. The const_share loop's non-generic callsite_ids must not steal or cross-attach either generic's monomorphization — Box stays 'yield once' (a=5) and Twice stays 'yield twice' (b=10). Exits 0 only when each generic call keeps its own instantiation.
